Definition: vast, whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty; of time, aged), or in number, many
BiblicalUsage: Kabbiyr is vastness — mighty in power, great in extent, aged in years. Bildad asks how long Job's words will be a strong wind; Elihu says God is mighty and does not despise any; and Isaiah pictures the Lord's strong and mighty one sweeping down like a storm of hail.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word is a reminder of scale. Our words feel vast to us and our troubles feel vast to us — but God is vaster, and His might is not against us but for us when we come to Him humbly.
